title: Engineering the connections that matter.
连接设备，也连接工艺。
intro: Vorntek develops inspection equipment and modular production systems. We bring mechanical engineering, workholding and controls together around the component and the operation.
Vorntek 致力于检测设备与模块化生产系统，将机械工程、工装定位与控制集成相结合，围绕工件与实际作业组织设备。

title: One process, several disciplines.
一项工艺，需要多方协同。
body: A camera, a fixture and a conveyor each solve part of a problem. Their timing, interfaces and operating conditions determine how the complete cell works. We consider those connections from the beginning.
相机、工装和输送模块各自解决一部分问题，它们的时序、接口与运行条件共同决定整个单元如何工作。我们从一开始就考虑这些连接。

title: Build from representative parts.
让方案建立在实际工件之上。
body: Drawings and representative samples help define the task. Surface variation, dimensional limits and the handling sequence are reviewed before equipment configuration and acceptance criteria are agreed.
图纸与代表性样件帮助定义任务。在确认配置与验收标准之前，先核对表面变化、尺寸范围与搬运顺序。

title: A clear boundary for integration.
为集成建立清楚边界。
body: Mechanical transfer, field wiring, network access and result exchange need named responsibilities. We make those interfaces part of the engineering discussion, along with installation, commissioning and support.
机械交接、现场接线、网络访问与结果交换都需要明确责任。这些接口与安装、调试和支持一样，属于工程讨论的一部分。

title: A working system starts at the interfaces.
系统能否协同，取决于接口细节。
intro: Mechanical stability, controlled measurement conditions and well-defined signals turn individual devices into a useful production cell.
机械稳定性、受控测量条件与明确信号，使单件设备形成可用的生产单元。

title: Workholding and repeatability
工装定位与重复性
body: Define the component datum, contact surfaces and loading sequence. Fixtures must position the part consistently while leaving access for the tool, sensor and operator.
明确工件基准、接触表面和上料顺序。工装既要稳定定位，也应为工具、传感器与操作人员保留空间。

title: Optics and measurement conditions
光学与测量条件
body: Part finish, ambient light, working distance and the tolerance all influence instrument selection. Evaluate representative variations rather than relying on a catalogue figure alone.
工件表面、环境光、工作距离与公差都会影响仪器选择，应验证代表性变化，不能只依据目录数字判断。

title: Signals and information exchange
信号与信息交换
body: Agree trigger, busy, ready and result meanings at the interface. Define how timestamps, product identifiers, interrupted connections and retries are handled by both sides.
约定接口中的触发、忙碌、就绪与结果含义，同时明确时间戳、产品标识、中断连接和重试的处理方式。

title: Access, guarding and maintenance
操作、防护与维护
body: Consider normal operation, clearing a fault, tool changes and service access separately. The final equipment configuration and protective measures require a project-specific assessment.
分别考虑正常操作、故障清除、换型与维护，最终设备配置及防护措施需要结合具体项目评估。

title: From the first sample to the next production step.
从第一件样品，到下一道生产工序。
intro: A defined engineering sequence helps turn a production requirement into equipment that can be installed, checked and supported.
通过明确的工程顺序，将生产需求转化为可以安装、核对与持续支持的设备。

title: Application review
应用评审
body: Share drawings, representative parts, target flow and site conditions. Identify the decisions the equipment needs to make and the limits of the current process.
提供图纸、代表性工件、目标流量与现场条件，明确设备需要作出的判断，以及现有工艺的限制。

title: Configuration and interface definition
配置与接口确认
body: Review the mechanical layout, workholding, instruments, utilities and control boundaries. Agree acceptance samples and the method for recording results.
核对机械布局、工装、仪器、能源条件与控制边界，确认验收样件及结果记录方式。

title: Installation and commissioning
安装与调试
body: Plan receiving, placement and connections with the site team. Commission the operation with representative parts, including changeover and the expected recovery paths.
与现场团队安排收货、就位和接线，使用代表性工件调试作业过程，同时覆盖换型与预期恢复路径。

title: Support with the right context
带着准确资料获得支持
body: Keep the equipment reference, configuration and acceptance records with the line. When conditions change, use those records to review adjustments and replacement requirements.
将设备编号、配置与验收记录随产线保留。条件变化时，可以据此讨论调整与更换需求。

title: Before choosing a vision inspection system
选择视觉检测系统之前
intro: Define the inspection decision before comparing cameras.
先定义检测判断，再比较相机。
sections: Collect meaningful samples
收集有代表性的样件
Include accepted parts, known defects and variations in material, colour and presentation. Record which differences should change the result.
准备良品、已知缺陷与材料、颜色和放置方式的变化，记录哪些差异应该影响检测结果。
State the acceptance boundary
写清验收边界
Specify the inspected features, allowable variation and how a disputed result will be reviewed. Align the inspection method with the drawing requirement.
明确检测特征、允许变化和争议结果的复核方式，让检测方法与图纸要求一致。
Include the handling sequence
把搬运顺序一起考虑
Review loading, settling, triggering, inspection and unloading. A camera exposure is only one part of the station cycle.
核对上料、稳定、触发、检测与下料，相机曝光只是整个工位周期的一部分。

title: Planning a modular assembly cell
模块化装配单元规划要点
intro: Let the work sequence determine the equipment arrangement.
让作业顺序决定设备布局。
sections: Observe the operation
观察实际作业
Record tools, reach distances, part presentation and the points where the operator waits or changes position.
记录工具、取放距离、物料呈现，以及人员等待或转换位置的环节。
Coordinate material flow
协调物料流动
Define transfer heights and buffer positions. Keep replenishment and maintenance routes clear of normal operation.
明确交接高度与缓存位置，补料和维护路径尽量不干扰正常作业。
Review the complete cycle
核对完整周期
Trial the full sequence with representative components, including changeover and fault recovery.
用代表性工件试运行完整顺序，并覆盖换型与故障恢复。

title: Preparing an existing line for integration
现有产线集成前的准备
intro: Document the interfaces and operating conditions before installation.
安装之前，先记录接口与运行条件。
sections: Establish the baseline
记录现有状态
Keep the current layout, wiring information, controller version and operating sequence available for the integration team.
为集成团队准备现有布局、接线资料、控制器版本与运行顺序。
Name the interface owner
明确接口负责人
Confirm who can change mechanical connections, control logic and network access. Agree test and recovery responsibilities.
确认谁负责机械连接、控制逻辑与网络访问变更，并约定测试和恢复责任。
Plan the installation window
安排安装窗口
Define the installation sequence, required resources, acceptance checks and the previous operating arrangement to restore if needed.
确定安装顺序、所需资源、验收检查，以及必要时恢复的原运行方式。
